title: Ankhorage Minikube Infrastructure
summary: Adapts portable infrastructure workloads to a caller-controlled Minikube cluster.
purpose: Provide a Minikube runtime boundary while reusing the shared Kubernetes driver for standard workload behavior.
responsibilities: Compose Minikube-specific cluster control with the shared Kubernetes workload driver.
Project and reconcile portable workloads on a selected Minikube cluster.
boundaries: Does not define portable infrastructure contracts.
Does not duplicate Kubernetes projection and reconciliation behavior.
Does not own a global Minikube installation or silently select a host profile.
audience: Infrastructure hosts selecting Minikube as a local runtime.
Developers testing portable workloads on a caller-controlled Minikube cluster.
useCases: Deploy a portable workload to Minikube.
Reconcile and inspect a Minikube-backed runtime.
Inject a Minikube command boundary suitable for the host or tests.

architecture.role: An infrastructure runtime adapter that combines Minikube control with the shared Kubernetes driver.
invariants: The caller supplies the Minikube-specific command boundary.
Standard Kubernetes behavior is delegated to @ankhorage/kubernetes.
Runtime results conform to the provider-neutral Infra contract.

configuration: A caller-provided Minikube command boundary is required.
limitations: Cluster provisioning semantics are limited to Minikube.
